view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. Multiple forklifts are parked on concrete floors near tall metal racks filled with stacked boxes and pallets. Yellow safety barriers are placed around equipment. The space is organized for storage and material handling operations.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift with 'REWE' branding is parked on the left side of the frame. It has a black seat and steering column. Its front bumper is visible, and it's positioned near yellow safety barriers. The forklift is stationary and partially obscured by a stack of black crates.

objects.label: stacked black crates
objects.observation: A tall, dense stack of black plastic crates sits on a wooden pallet in the center-left area. Each crate has white labels. The stack is adjacent to a forklift and partially blocks the view of the background shelves. It appears heavy and stable on its pallet base.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: High metal shelving units line the right and center of the warehouse, holding various boxes and goods. Some shelves have green electrical boxes mounted on them. The units extend vertically into the ceiling, indicating multi-level storage. They are supported by steel frames and appear firmly anchored to the floor.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic barriers are placed on the floor near the forklifts and along aisles. One is directly under the forklift on the left, another is near the central forklift. These barriers are low, rectangular, and appear to be freestanding, likely used to define safe zones or block traffic.

objects.label: orange forklift (right)
objects.observation: Another orange forklift is parked on the right side of the frame, facing slightly toward the camera. It has a black seat and steering column. A person wearing red clothing is seated inside. This forklift is positioned near a shelf unit and appears stationary.

<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s5-35822", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
